The directions provide the broad principles which shall be complied with by all the participants in the payment chain, while using a form of authentication. While these directions are applicable only to domestic transactions, in order to provide a similar level of safety for online international transactions undertaken using cards issued in India, the directions also incorporate necessary instructions for specific cross-border card transactions, in line with the [Statement on Developmental and Regulatory Policies****dated February 07, 2025](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=59693). These directions are issued under Section 18 read with Section 10(2) of the Payment and Settlement Systems (PSS) Act, 2007 (Act 51 of 2007).

Subject: Standardization in McC (Merchant category codes)for BHiM Aadhaar Pay Dear Sir/Madam, BHiM Aadhaar Pay(BAP) allows merchants to accept digital payments from customers using the Aadhaar biometric authentication. As per the current implementation of BHIM Aadhar Pay by the members, acquiring banks send MCC in the BHIM Aadhaar Pay online transaction request. However, the MCC value is set to a default value of ‘6012' for all merchants, thereby creating considerable difficuity in classifying merchants into specific categories based on the type of business OR trade or services supplied by the merchants. In order to ease the process of classifying merchants and tracking BHIM Aadhar Pay transactions, all the members are advised to ensure that the appropriate MCc is passed in the online transaction request as per the specifications defined by Iso (International Organisation for Standardization). All members are advised to implement the above instructions of sending the appropriate MCC for BHIM Aadhar Pay in online request to AePS (NPCI) latest by 28th February 2022.
